release_notes:
What's New in v1.1.3

- Fixed Video Rendering: Resolved issue where video was not showing for participants and local camera on mobile & web.
- Fixed Screen Sharing Audio: Screen share video audio now stays connected and broadcasting even when the presenter's microphone is muted.
- Fixed Ringing Ignore Button: One-tap instant dismissal and missed call logging when declining incoming calls.
- Fixed Side Call Cut Button: Instant, clean hangup from floating Pop Player PiP widget and hardware buttons.
- Performance, audio clarity & stability improvements across video meetings.
